words.def: A spoon is a tool you use to eat soup or cereal. It has a little bowl at one end.
ask: What food do you eat with a spoon ?
words.sentence: I ate my cereal with a spoon.
words.adultDef: A spoon is something we use to eat with. It has a handle and a little round bowl at the end – great for soup, cereal and ice cream!

words.def: The moon is the bright round thing we see in the sky at night.
ask: When can you see the moon ?
words.sentence: The moon was big and bright in the night sky.
words.adultDef: The moon is the big round ball we can see in the sky, mostly at night. Sometimes it looks round and full, and sometimes it looks like a thin smile.

words.def: Food is what we eat to stay healthy and strong.
words.adultDef: Food is what we eat to give our body energy and help us grow – like fruit, bread, pasta and vegetables. Animals need food too!

words.def: Soon means in a short time from now. It is not long to wait!
ask: What is something fun that is happening soon ?
words.adultDef: Soon means in a short time – not long from now. "Lunch will be ready soon." "We will be there soon!"

words.def: Noon is twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.
ask: What do you usually do at noon ?
words.sentence: We had a picnic at noon, right in the middle of the day.
words.adultDef: Noon is 12 o’clock in the middle of the day – it is also called midday . The sun is high in the sky and it is nearly time for lunch!

words.def: A zoo is a place where you can go to see lots of animals.
ask: What animals would you like to see at the zoo ?
words.sentence: We saw a kangaroo and a koala at the zoo.
words.adultDef: A zoo is a place where wild animals live and people can visit them – like kangaroos, lions, giraffes and seals. Zookeepers feed them and look after them.
